remapping_proposal.current_architecture: Analyzed 25 code file(s) (6454 LOC, 148 functions, 3 classes) in `Tidy-Idy`. Currently, `bin/hygiene.mjs` interleaves Stage 1 I/O (reading `tidy-idy` config/markdown files, environment variables, and subprocess flags) with Stage 2 domain logic (`checkProjectHygiene`) and Stage 3 file writes, forcing unit tests to mock filesystem/CLI state.

proposed_functional_core.responsibilities: Executes `Tidy-Idy` domain scoring, structural transformation, and convergence/invariant verification purely over in-memory value objects with zero I/O.
invariants: Referential transparency: identical (state, policy) inputs always yield bit-identical outputs.
Zero filesystem, subprocess, clock, or network calls inside the core module.

proposed_functional_core.responsibilities: Evaluates schema well-formedness, cross-family honesty stamps (`cross_model`), and stopping gates.
invariants: Fail-closed: missing or self-reviewed verification stamps return HALT/DEGRADED explicitly.

proposed_imperative_shell.boundary_kind: INGEST (Filesystem + SQLite Librarian KB + Model Prefs)
proposed_imperative_shell.responsibilities: Reads SKILL.md, ~/.anchor/model_prefs.json, and SQLite Librarian knowledge base records; validates path containment before constructing ImmutableDomainState.

proposed_imperative_shell.boundary_kind: EMIT (Subscription CLI Dispatch + Atomic Artifact & Journal Writer)
proposed_imperative_shell.responsibilities: Dispatches cross-family review via subscription CLIs (claude.exe / agy-dispatch / grok-cli) and atomically persists deliverables plus `journal/runs/<run_id>.json` receipts.

progressive_nodes.title: Stage 1 · Ingest, Triage & Librarian KB Grounding (Tidy-Idy)

level1_summary.purpose: Parses operator intent, enforces path containment, resolves `~/.anchor/model_prefs.json` seating, and loads prior `Tidy-Idy` lessons from the Librarian KB.

subflow_steps: 1. Parse and schema-validate input arguments in `bin/hygiene.mjs::runHygieneCheck`.
2. Resolve complexity band (`regular` vs `heavy`) and bind subscription CLI seats (`coding_family`, `review_family`).
3. Query Librarian KB & `journal/` to attach prior validated claims and prevent cold-start drift.
assumptions: All input file paths reside inside allowed discovery roots with zero `..` traversal segments.
Model seating preferences come exclusively from `~/.anchor/model_prefs.json` (Universal Seating Law).
level2_mechanics.old_to_new_diff: Extracts inline `fs.readFileSync` / `os.environ` reads out of domain functions into a single typed `IngestAdapter`.

progressive_nodes.title: Stage 3 · Cross-Family Adversarial Verification & Invariant Gate (Tidy-Idy)

level1_summary.purpose: Audits `Tidy-Idy` candidate outputs against deterministic invariants and cross-family adversarial reviewers (`review_family != coding_family`).

subflow_steps: 2. Dispatch fresh-context adversarial review to `review_family` via subscription CLI (`agy-dispatch` / `claude.exe` / `grok-cli`).
3. Enforce ≥2-reviewer agreement on BLOCKERs or fail-closed honesty stamp (`cross_model: true/false`).
level2_mechanics.formal_invariant_or_equation: Accept(A) ⟺ Gate_det(A) = PASS ∧ (Family(Reviewer) ≠ Family(Coder) ∨ Stamp = DEGRADED)
assumptions: A verification seat never silently self-reviews; any failover stamps the actual `model_served` and `cross_model: false`.
Deterministic machine gates run in the host orchestrator process, never trusted to prose claims.
level2_mechanics.old_to_new_diff: Separates pure verdict adjudication (`verify_contract_pure`) from subprocess CLI transport.
